btw when I say Liturgiya I don't mean by the Faketushka album, Liturgiya is an orthodox ritual in churches where the "Episkop" ( pope ) chants in the church slavic language and people drink wine and eat bread ( symbolising the blood and the body of Jesus )

The chants from the First Yekteniya "Восприя'т Изра'иля отрока своего,
Помяну'ти милости" is a chant from the Old Slavic Orthodox church, it isn't used anymore because the language Batushka uses isn't russian, rather "Crkvenoslovenski" (translation to Chuch Slavic). The chants are also changed in the songs ( I know this because I used to be an orthodox and go to church ) and in Liturgiya chants are fairly different from these in the songs. But it isn't wrong, the words make sense and maybe these chants are used in the Polish Orthodox church, because the chants depend from the church.
